confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on several 2026-dated or recent aggregator and guide figures, but they conflict and the peso moves fast with high inflation. Beer and coffee USD values use an implied rate of about 1,386 ARS per USD from a February 2026 source, which may not match the July 2026 window. Wine glass has no usable 2026 Buenos Aires data; it is set from the local price relationship to beer (ARS 4,000-6,200 per glass versus ARS 5,300-6,000 per beer). Cocktail uses Expatistan and World's 50 Best averages, which are undated or mixed-currency. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and regional context, not checked against live listings. The FX observation (0.6720 USD per AUD, 18 Nov 2026) was reported by search results citing the RBA page and a third-party aggregator; I did not directly read the rba.gov.au table, so verify it there.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink anchors are based on Buenos Aires-specific price guides and aggregated venue averages. Accommodation anchors are regional estimates benchmarked against mid-sized Latin American capitals with comparable tourist demand, with no live-listing check.
